theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: Despite the absence of return forecast from the momentum rank, AI Compute & Optics exhibits the strongest eligible trend, high durability (bar 0.75), broad participation (breadth 0.765), and is not crowded. This suggests relative strength may persist as long as the trend structure holds, but China's mean-reverting tape and the gate's historical failure to cut drawdown demand extreme caution.
evidence: Crowding z-score 0.05 (not crowded), so no sizing-cap trigger
Eligible under the absolute-trend gate, meaning internal trend health is intact
theses.dissent: China A-shares historically mean-revert strongly; the absolute-trend gate failed to reduce drawdown in this market, and rapid policy/geopolitical shifts (macro backdrop dominated by geopolitics and unscheduled surprises) can abruptly reverse momentum. The crowded Semiconductors challenger may also create spillover selling if it unwinds.
